description: Shell sessions: inside an Airdress shell session only (AIRDRESS_SHELL_SOCKET set by the host), report this session's events to the shell host on this machine, and pass back the person's answer to a permission prompt from their phone. Outside one, every hook exits at once and does nothing.

hooks.command: [ -n "$AIRDRESS_SHELL_SOCKET" ] || exit 0; command -v airdress >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec airdress shell events
